subject.title: Google Chat: Add user OAuth support for reactions and media uploads

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add a first-class user OAuth credential surface for reactions, uploads, reaction typing, and proactive DM lookup, and what storage/scope model should it use?
rationale: Source review proves the missing capability, but accepting user OAuth changes the channel's credential, consent, scope, token-refresh, and routing security boundary, which needs maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Approve Plugin-Owned OAuth Design
options.body: Define the Google Chat OAuth credential model inside the plugin, including storage/redaction, token refresh, scoped clients, fallback behavior, setup docs, and live proof.

options.title: Limit Current Work To Fallbacks
options.body: Handle app-auth upload failures through the existing media-fallback PRs and keep reactions, native uploads, reaction typing, and proactive email-alias DMs unsupported until OAuth is separately sponsored.

options.title: Defer Bundled OAuth Surface
options.body: Leave bundled Google Chat service-account-only for now and request an external plugin or design proposal if maintainers do not want this credential surface in the official plugin yet.

recommendation.title: Approve Plugin-Owned OAuth Design
recommendation.body: Define the Google Chat OAuth credential model inside the plugin, including storage/redaction, token refresh, scoped clients, fallback behavior, setup docs, and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current routing signal from prior review on this exact issue and sustained Google Chat auth/API/docs history.
